text: A bald, muscular male figure with a heavy build stands in profile, gazing upward at a starry night sky. His skin is pale pinkish-beige. He wears a sleeveless red tunic over dark pants, accessorized with gold bracelets on his right wrist and an earring. One hand rests near his chin, the other clenched at his waist. Behind him, heavy red curtains frame a stone balcony railing. The scene is framed by deep blue night sky speckled with stars.
